mapper.select: SELECT M.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, M.NAME AS name, M.EMAIL AS email, D.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS departmentName, P.POSITION_NAME AS positionName FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPARTMENT_ID = M.DEPARTMENT_ID LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON P.POSITION_ID = M.POSITION_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND M.STATUS = 'Y'

SELECT C.COURSE_ID AS courseId, C.COURSE_TITLE AS courseTitle, C.END_DATE AS endDate, CEIL(C.END_DATE - SYSDATE) AS dDay, NVL(PROG.PROGRESS_RATE, 0) AS progressRate, CASE WHEN C.END_DATE < SYSDATE THEN 'CLOSED' WHEN NVL(PROG.PROGRESS_RATE, 0) >= 100 THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'IN_PROGRESS' END AS courseStatus FROM ENROLLMENT E JOIN COURSE C ON C.COURSE_ID = E.COURSE_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CP.ENROLLMENT_ID, ROUND( COUNT(CASE WHEN CP.IS_COMPLETED = 'Y' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100 ) AS PROGRESS_RATE FROM CHAPTER_PROGRESS CP GROUP BY CP.ENROLLMENT_ID ) PROG ON PROG.ENROLLMENT_ID = E.ENROLLMENT_ID WHERE E.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND E.STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY CASE WHEN C.END_DATE < SYSDATE THEN 2 WHEN NVL(PROG.PROGRESS_RATE, 0) >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CEIL(C.END_DATE - SYSDATE) ASC

SELECT A.ASSIGNMENT_ID AS assignmentId, A.ASSIGNMENT_TITLE AS assignmentTitle, A.DUE_DATE AS dueDate, C.COURSE_TITLE AS courseTitle, CASE WHEN SUB.SUBMISSION_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'SUBMITTED' ELSE 'NOT_SUBMITTED' END AS submitStatus FROM ENROLLMENT E JOIN COURSE C ON C.COURSE_ID = E.COURSE_ID JOIN ASSIGNMENT A ON A.COURSE_ID = C.COURSE_ID LEFT JOIN ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION SUB ON SUB.ASSIGNMENT_ID = A.ASSIGNMENT_ID AND SUB.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} WHERE E.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND E.STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY CASE WHEN SUB.SUBMISSION_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, A.DUE_DATE ASC
